// units writer, generated by kohakutt.dsl.metal.
// Change the program's model, not this file.
#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: out address, acc address, rows_base, rows_extra.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto out_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr auto acc_args = TensorAccessorArgs<out_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_out = 16, cb_acc = 17;
    const uint32_t out_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t acc_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t rows_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t rows_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = rows_base + (core < rows_extra ? 1 : 0);
    const uint32_t start = (core * rows_base) + (core < rows_extra ? core : rows_extra);
    const auto out = TensorAccessor(out_args, out_addr, 2048);
    const auto acc = TensorAccessor(acc_args, acc_addr, 4096);
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < count; ++m) {
        cb_wait_front(cb_out, 2);
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
            noc_async_write_page(((start + m) * 2) + j, out, get_read_ptr(cb_out) + j * 2048);
        }
        cb_wait_front(cb_acc, 1);
        noc_async_write_page(start + m, acc, get_read_ptr(cb_acc));
        noc_async_writes_flushed();
        cb_pop_front(cb_out, 2);
        cb_pop_front(cb_acc, 1);
    }
    noc_async_write_barrier();
}
